ubsan: Both probe translation units instrumented with undefined-behavior sanitizer and no recovery; no diagnostics. The linked TKernel library is not fully instrumented. No overflowing native UpperRow/UpperCol expression is evaluated.

red_phase.result: Six initial tests: three passed and three failed for row-only, column-only and combined near-maximum origins. The final nine-test target adds actual-backing guards, stable error payloads and empty huge shape coverage.

changes: Replace Array2 bounded index validation against wrapped upper bounds with widened index-minus-lower and usize size comparison, matching native offsetOf.
Preserve valid initialized storage checks and existing wrapped diagnostic bounds; getters with undefined native overflow are not used in the native oracle.
Bind the 66 reviewed native declarations to existing concrete methods, trait bodies, standard-library move composition or compiled drop glue. Add no public aliases.
classification: The 66 review rows were evidence gaps, not 66 missing implementations. Sixty-one map to existing reachable methods, two to Default trait bodies, two to std::mem::take plus Default and one to generated drop glue.
One real defined-behavior defect was found and fixed: valid Array2 indices were rejected after near-maximum lower-bound updates.
The original checklist retains thirteen template-owned CXXMethod children as duplicates of their FunctionTemplate wrappers. None occur in these 66 reviewed rows or earn separate credit.
Direct Array2 forwarding methods such as flat At(size_t) are bound to their own exact wrappers (at_offset/change_at_offset); inherited Array1 storage remains a distinct dependency.
limitations: Each proposed binding retains a partial domain. No blanket full API parity, class completion, or new global inventory/legacy mapping credit is claimed.

Native signed-overflow expressions remain outside the defined domain. Integer narrowing observations use the pinned native int32/size_t64 ABI. Rust wrapping/checked extensions do not establish native undefined behavior parity.

Generated drop and standard-library move evidence is specialized to the non-Clone SurfaceCell test type and pinned compiler binaries; generic source metadata explains the composition. Explicit raw destruction, virtual/placement deletion and throwing destructors remain open.

Array1 resize already has a Rust method, but native trivial allocation/reallocation behavior, uninitialized tails and nontrivial constructor-failure leaks remain partial. No duplicate callback method is introduced.
Arbitrary raw pointer/count metadata, independently overlapping mutable views, writable const-cast buffer aliases and allocator macro routing remain open.

The base excludes pending adc02269 internal Emplace and 5448462b uninitialized-constructor code. Their immutable checklist/evidence drives reconciliation, but their test targets are not claimed rerun here; root must combine them after integration.
